The header then reads "N selected" and has Select All, and an action bar offers the list's actions. Ctrl/Cmd+A selects every row, Escape leaves, and in the Characters, Groups, Persona, Backgrounds, Tag Manager and Folders lists Shift+click or Shift+Space or Enter extends a range. The lists and their actions: Characters (More… ▸ Select): Favorite, Tag, Move to Folder, Duplicate, Convert to Persona and Delete; Groups: Tag, Move to Folder and Delete. Personas (Persona Management ▸ Select): Move to Folder, Duplicate and Delete. World Info entries (the book menu ▸ Select): Enable, Disable, Move/Copy and Delete. Agents (Agents Menu ▸ Select): Turn On, Turn Off, Edit Properties… and Delete…. Prompts (Prompt List Actions ▸ Select): Turn On, Turn Off, Remove From List and Delete. Backgrounds (Background ▸ ⋮ ▸ Select, Global tab only; on a touch screen a long press opens the thumbnail's menu instead): Move to Folder and Delete. Tag Manager and Folders window: Delete only. Deleting asks first and states the count. The Sort button sits at the end of a list's search bar and shows as pressed while the list is not in its default order: Characters and Groups (a sort, plus List or Grid), Personas (A-Z, Z-A), the Tag Manager, the Chat Completion prompt list and the Backgrounds gallery each offer their own options. Show More is a button at the end of the Characters, Groups, Persona and Tag Manager lists that loads the next rows. From the keyboard, Down from the last row reaches Show More, and Enter on it loads the next rows and moves focus to the first new row; the arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up and Page Down move between the rows (see Keyboard Shortcuts, List Navigation).

82.comment: A82 The Tag Manager and the Folders window
82.content: Tag Manager (window "Tag Management"): Characters ▸ More… ▸ Manage Tags. The search bar has a Sort button with the radio items Manual (Drag & Drop), Alphabetical (A-Z) and Most Used (By Count). The header's ⋮ menu holds Select, Backup, Restore and Prune. A tag shows how many entries use it ("1 entry" for one). It lists 50 tags at a time, and Show More loads the next 50; a new search starts again at the first 50. Selection mode offers Delete only, after "Delete N tags? This cannot be undone." With no tags the page says "Create a New Tag" with a New button, and a search with no match says "No Results". Folders window (title "Folders"): one window for the scope of the list it was opened from: Characters or Groups (Characters ▸ More… ▸ Manage Folders), Personas (Persona Management ▸ Manage Folders) or Backgrounds (Background ▸ ⋮ ▸ Manage Folders). The header has Search, a ⋮ menu with Select and New Folder (+). Each folder row has a name that can be edited, a member count and a Manage Folder menu with Rename, Colour, Expanded by Default, the move items and Delete; opening a row shows its members, with an Add button that opens "Add to Folder". Deleting a folder asks "Delete Folder?" and keeps its members. Selection mode offers Delete only. With no folders the page says "No Folders" with a New Folder button, and a folder with no members says "No Members".

83.content: Customize ▸ Appearance ▸ Chat Display has two position settings for the messages that pop up over the interface: "Notifications" and "Toasts". Both offer Top Left, Top Center, Top Right, Bottom Left, Bottom Center and Bottom Right. A choice applies at once and is saved with the other settings. Neither is part of a UI theme, so changing the theme leaves them as they are. "Toasts" places toasts: short plain messages, such as a confirmation, with no title, one line of text and at most one button. It starts at Bottom Center. "Notifications" places in-app notifications: messages with a title, several parts, more than one button, a click action or text that does not fit on one line. It starts at Top Center. While a dialog is open, a toast keeps the position that "Toasts" gives it and shows above the dialog and its dimming, so it can be read and dismissed. The dimming covers the message box, so a bottom toast sits a little above the window edge. On a phone, where a dialog is a sheet that rises from the bottom, a bottom toast sits above the top of the sheet, and above the buttons at the foot of the sheet when the sheet reaches too far up to leave room above it. In-app notifications keep their place in the window, and a bottom one sits at the window edge. When "Toasts" and "Notifications" are set to the same position, a toast and the in-app notifications form one stack, with the toast nearest the edge. At a bottom position, a message sits above the message box, and above a sheet that is docked at the bottom of the window (on a phone, the action menu and the sheet of a side panel), whichever reaches highest. At Bottom Center it is centred on that bar, and at Bottom Left and Bottom Right it sits against its start or its end, so it follows a message box that a docked side panel has moved to one side. When a panel such as Backend or Customize covers the message box, or the message box has been moved away from the bottom of the window, a bottom message sits at the window edge instead. A toast closes with its Dismiss button, and tapping the toast does nothing. A toast stays for 5 seconds. An in-app notification stays as long as its kind says: an error or a warning stays until it is dismissed, and an info or success message goes after 4 seconds. A timeout that a message sets itself wins over both. At most three in-app notifications show at once, and the others wait and show as one goes. An in-app notification closes with its Dismiss button, and a click on the card, outside its buttons and links, runs its action, if it has one, and closes it. A click that ends a text selection in the card, such as a double click on a word or a drag over the text, neither runs its action nor closes it, so the text of a message that stays can be copied. A slash command /echo with a title, the severity error or warning, awaitDismissal=true and no timeout therefore waits until its notification is dismissed.
